import re

# Login to simple_note and fetch the 'Movie Recommendations' note
simple_note_user='gl.moore@gmail.com'
simple_note_pwd='aVfy)Rr'
note_id=1556

sn_access_token=apis.simple_note.login(username=simple_note_user,password=simple_note_pwd)['access_token']
note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=sn_access_token)
content=note['content']

# Extract movie titles that have a line like "- director: Quentin Tarantino"
# We'll parse blocks that start with a title line (no leading '-') followed by metadata lines.
lines=content.splitlines()
movies=[]
current_title=None
current_director=None
for line in lines:
    stripped=line.strip()
    if not stripped:
        continue
    if not stripped.startswith('-') and not stripped.startswith('#'):
        # title line
        current_title=stripped
        current_director=None
    elif stripped.startswith('- director:'):
        current_director=stripped.split(':',1)[1].strip()
        if current_title is not None:
            movies.append((current_title,current_director))

# Determine titles whose director is exactly Quentin Tarantino
qt_titles=[title for title,dirr in movies if dirr=='Quentin Tarantino']
# De-duplicate while preserving order
seen=set(); qt_titles_unique=[]
for t in qt_titles:
    if t not in seen:
        seen.add(t)
        qt_titles_unique.append(t)

print('note_title',note['title'])
print('extracted_quentin_tarantino_titles_count',len(qt_titles_unique))
print('titles',qt_titles_unique)
